svg.title: Provisioning flow for native Arch and WSL
svg.desc: Two profiles share package lists and chezmoi source state. Native installs desktop extras and services. WSL installs CLI extras and optionally uses systemd.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
